title_en: Upcoming: speaking at Hongqiao Tech Week, Shanghai (20–22 Nov)
title_zh: 即将登场：上海虹桥科技周（11月20–22日）演讲嘉宾
summary_en: Chris is a confirmed speaker at Hongqiao Tech Week, held at the National Exhibition and Convention Center (NECC) in Shanghai from 20 to 22 November 2026. Session details will be added once the agenda is published.
summary_zh: 彭家荣已确认担任虹桥科技周演讲嘉宾。活动于2026年11月20日至22日在上海国家会展中心举行，具体场次将在议程公布后更新。
caption: Chris Pereira, speaker at Hongqiao Tech Week 2026, Shanghai

title_en: “East meets West” panel at Web Summit Lisbon
title_zh: 在里斯本 Web Summit 参加“东西方相遇”圆桌讨论
summary_en: Chris joined the Commerce Summit panel “East meets West: why AI products land differently across markets” with Angela Yu of StoReel and Young Wang of Acti, moderated by Grace Shao of AI Proem. He said the lesson of China's rise is competition, and that trust matters more than any specific technology.
summary_zh: 彭家荣参加 Commerce Summit 圆桌“东西方相遇：AI 产品为何在不同市场表现不同”，与 StoReel 的 Angela Yu、Acti 的 Young Wang 同台，由 AI Proem 的 Grace Shao 主持。他认为中国崛起带来的启示是竞争，信任比任何具体的技术都更重要。
quote_en: What China is teaching us is not that we need to copy China's government or their systems, but that competition, which China learned from the West by the way, works.
quote_zh: 中国教给我们的，不是要照搬中国的政府或制度，而是竞争是有效的。顺便说一句，这是中国向西方学来的。
caption: Chris Pereira speaking on stage at Web Summit Lisbon, November 2026. Photo: Hugo Moreira / Web Summit

event: 一财全球十周年生态大会暨新十年战略发布
title_en: Panel at Yicai Global's 10th Anniversary Ecosystem Conference, Shanghai
title_zh: 在一财全球十周年生态大会暨新十年战略发布（上海）参加圆桌讨论
summary_en: Chris joined a Yicai panel in Shanghai with Jiang Yan, Chen Shuihai of BIPO and Lu Yao of the Shanghai Academy of Social Sciences. He said talk of a global retreat is inaccurate, since Chinese firms going abroad mark a new generation of globalisation.
summary_zh: 彭家荣在上海参加第一财经圆桌讨论，与云隙咨询的蒋燕、BIPO的陈水海、上海社科院的卢尧同台。他认为“全球化退潮”的说法并不准确，中国企业出海是新一代全球化的特征。
quote_en: When Chinese companies go out into the world one by one, what stands behind them is further globalisation.
quote_zh: 一个个出海企业走向世界的时候，背后是进一步的全球化。
